name: Nibbles Rewards Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APR of the U.S. Prime Rate + 17.74% (currently 24.74%), with a maximum of 29.99%.

base_rate.description: 1x points (1 point = $0.01) everywhere else Mastercard is accepted.

categories.label: Pet stores, pet services and licensed veterinarians

rewards.redemption_notes: Points currently redeem for statement credits; options include pet-related expenses and merchandise.

benefits.title: Included pet insurance
benefits.description: Pet health insurance for one pet with the premium paid by Nibbles (80% reimbursement after a $700 annual deductible, up to $10,000 per year, or other plan options), subject to eligibility.

notes: Nibbles is a program manager; the card is issued by Lead Bank and is a World Mastercard Program, per the Nibbles site.
